column1: # Total basis: union of Ghidra functions and recovered callbacks/entries.

column2: note
function start — GearHelperInitializeMesh; initializes model mesh state.
function start — GearHelperInitializeSkeleton; initializes model skeleton state.
function start — GearHelperUpdateSkeletonTransforms; propagates parent joint transforms and dirty state.
function start — GearHelperNoOpCallback; intentional empty callback.
function start — GearHelperFreeModelSkeleton; frees skeleton nodes and their array.
function start — GearHelperFreeModelMesh; frees model mesh state.
function start — GearHelperObjectPoolInitialize; initializes the helper object pool.
function start — GearHelperObjectPoolFree; frees the helper object pool.
function start — GearHelperObjectPoolReset; resets object-pool allocation state.
function start — GearHelperObjectPoolRelease; releases one pooled object.
function start — GearHelperInitializeVertexBuffer; initializes a model vertex buffer.
function start — GearHelperFreeVertexBuffer; frees a model vertex buffer.
function start — GearHelperInitializeVertices; initializes model vertices.
function start — GearHelperVertexAllocate; allocates one helper vertex record.
function start — GearHelperVertexRelease; releases one helper vertex record.
function start — GearHelperVertexUpdateAndRender; updates and renders helper vertices.
function start — GearHelperGetModelJointMatrix; resolves a model joint matrix.
function start — GearHelperInitialize; initializes the shared Gear model helper.
function start — GearHelperInitializeModelAuxObjects; initializes model auxiliary objects.
